name: How do I handle negotiations and offers when selling my home FSBO?

mainEntity.name: How do I handle negotiations and offers when selling my home FSBO?

acceptedAnswer.text: When handling FSBO negotiations, respond promptly and professionally to all offers. Focus on the total net proceeds, not just the initial offer price. Be prepared to counter-offer, addressing terms like closing costs, contingencies, and closing dates. Understanding current market conditions in areas like Broward County can inform your negotiation strategy and is a crucial decision factor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Handle FSBO negotiations by responding promptly, focusing on net proceeds, and being prepared to counter-offer on price and terms.
